name: The Upriver Exile
description: Wherever Shaashak and Khadi settled after leaving Lothal by river skiff, and where Sarita was born.
notes: From `event_exile_of_shaashak` and `event_birth_of_sarita`. Canon says only that it is upriver and far from Lothal's tainted legacy — deliberately unlocated, which is the point of an exile.
